_sources.measured: ALEPH, DELPHI, L3, OPAL, SLD, LEP EWWG, SLD EW and Heavy Flavour groups, Precision Electroweak Measurements on the Z Resonance, Phys. Rept. 427 (2006) 257, arXiv:hep-ex/0509008: Table 2.13 (lineshape, lepton universality) and Tables 5.10-5.11 (heavy flavour, 14-parameter fit). A_l (LEP, SLD), sin2theta_eff (Q_FB, Tevatron): Gfitter Table 1 and its footnote.
_sources.sm: J. Haller et al. (Gfitter), Update of the global electroweak fit and constraints on two-Higgs-doublet models, Eur. Phys. J. C 78 (2018) 675, arXiv:1803.01853, Table 1, fourth column (full fit).
_sources.note: The heavy-flavour correlations are the 6x6 block of the 14-parameter matrix (Table 5.11). The M_Z row of Table 2.13 is dropped: M_Z is an input here; its correlations with the others are at most 0.055.

validation._source: J. Erler, P. Langacker, S. Munir and E. Rojas, Improved Constraints on Z' Bosons from Electroweak Precision Data, JHEP 08 (2009) 017, arXiv:0906.2435, Tables 4 (rho_0 = 1) and 5 (rho_0 free): 95% CL range of sin theta_ZZ'. Their fit also uses low-energy data, M_W, and floats M_H, alpha_s.
